answer.justification: All outputs are identical to the reference. Exact-match rate is 1.000, median first divergence is 64 and edit distance is 0.000. Every text rate matches the reference exactly: refusals, disclaimers, stage directions, reply length, no preference mentions and no marker prefix. Quantization, the class most easily confused with no change, matches the reference exactly on only about 2% of prompts (0.021 ± 0.009), so 64 of 64 identical replies is far outside its range. The fine-tunes and both system-prompt classes also diverge on nearly every prompt. Logit and activation levels were not measured, so exact zeros there could not be confirmed, which keeps confidence a little below certainty.
